result.instructions: Tools for Kommo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open deals are in our sales pipeline, and what is the total value by stage?"; "Show the contacts and companies that were updated this week."; "List my open tasks for today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kommo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kommo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kommo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kommo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kommo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kommo_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Kommo account: id, subdomain, country, currency and the current user id. Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /api/v4/account.

with.description: Comma-separated extra data to embed, e.g. 'contacts,loss_reason' (see the Kommo reference for each entity).

tools.name: kommo_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the lead pipelines with their stages (status ids, names, sort order). Use it to find the pipeline_id and status_id values for lead filters and writes. GET /api/v4/leads/pipelines.

tools.name: kommo_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the account with their ids, names, emails and roles. Use it to find responsible_user_id values. GET /api/v4/users.

with.description: Comma-separated extra data to embed, e.g. 'contacts,loss_reason' (see the Kommo reference for each entity).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use _links.next in the result to see whether another page exists.

tools.name: kommo_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of leads, contacts or companies (ids, names, types, enum options). Use it to find field ids before writing values. GET /api/v4/{entity}/custom_fields.

entity.description: Entity type: leads, contacts or companies.

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use _links.next in the result to see whether another page exists.

tools.name: kommo_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List deals (leads) with price, stage, pipeline, responsible user and timestamps. Filter by text, pipeline, owner or the update window. One request per call. GET /api/v4/leads.

query.description: Search text across the filled lead fields.

responsible_user_id.description: Only leads owned by this user id.

updated_from.description: Only leads updated at or after this Unix time.

updated_to.description: Only leads updated at or before this Unix time.

with.description: Comma-separated extra data to embed, e.g. 'contacts,loss_reason' (see the Kommo reference for each entity).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use _links.next in the result to see whether another page exists.

tools.name: kommo_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: Get one lead by id, with optional embedded data (contacts, loss_reason, source). GET /api/v4/leads/{id}.

with.description: Comma-separated extra data to embed, e.g. 'contacts,loss_reason' (see the Kommo reference for each entity).

tools.name: kommo_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) with their names, custom fields (email, phone) and responsible user. One request per call. GET /api/v4/contacts.

query.description: Search text, e.g. a name, email or phone.

responsible_user_id.description: Only contacts owned by this user id.

with.description: Comma-separated extra data to embed, e.g. 'contacts,loss_reason' (see the Kommo reference for each entity).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use _links.next in the result to see whether another page exists.

tools.name: kommo_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with optional embedded data (leads, companies). GET /api/v4/contacts/{id}.

with.description: Comma-separated extra data to embed, e.g. 'contacts,loss_reason' (see the Kommo reference for each entity).

tools.name: kommo_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies (organisations) with their names, custom fields and responsible user. One request per call. GET /api/v4/companies.

query.description: Search text, e.g. a company name.

responsible_user_id.description: Only companies owned by this user id.

with.description: Comma-separated extra data to embed, e.g. 'contacts,loss_reason' (see the Kommo reference for each entity).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use _links.next in the result to see whether another page exists.

tools.name: kommo_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get one company by id, with optional embedded data (contacts, leads). GET /api/v4/companies/{id}.

with.description: Comma-separated extra data to embed, e.g. 'contacts,loss_reason' (see the Kommo reference for each entity).

tools.name: kommo_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List follow-up tasks, optionally only open ones, for one user or one linked entity. One request per call. GET /api/v4/tasks.

responsible_user_id.description: Only tasks for this user id.

is_completed.description: true = completed only; false = open only.

entity_type.description: Only tasks linked to this entity type.

entity_id.description: Only tasks linked to this entity id (use with entity_type).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use _links.next in the result to see whether another page exists.

tools.name: kommo_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List the notes (comments, calls, status changes) of one lead, contact or company. One request per call. GET /api/v4/{entity}/{id}/notes.

entity.description: Entity type: leads, contacts or companies.

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use _links.next in the result to see whether another page exists.

tools.name: kommo_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: Create one lead (deal) in a pipeline stage. Creates a new record on every call: it does not check for duplicates. POST /api/v4/leads.

status_id.description: Stage id inside the pipeline (see kommo_list_pipelines).

tools.name: kommo_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: Change one lead: name, value, pipeline, stage or owner. Only the given fields change. Repeating the same call gives the same result. PATCH /api/v4/leads/{id}.

status_id.description: Move to this stage id (inside the pipeline).
